ration_stores.label: Ration the stores
ration_stores.description: Everyone eats less so the stores last. Tempers fray.

press_volunteers.label: Press volunteers
press_volunteers.description: With a threat at the door, every able hand is told to take a post. Nobody thanks you.
press_volunteers.result: Six more hands take a post. Your districts resent it.

strip_a_building.label: Strip a building for parts
strip_a_building.description: Tear the fittings out of one of your buildings and sell them on for materials.
strip_a_building.result: A building is gone and its fittings are in the stores.

market_day.label: Market day
market_day.description: Open the roads and the stalls for a day. Traders hear of it and come back.
market_day.result: Trade income is up for 90 days.

pay_the_watch.label: Pay the watch
pay_the_watch.description: Wages for people who walk the streets at night, so others don't have to.
pay_the_watch.result: Grievance falls and attacks on your land are harder for 180 days.

district_feast.label: A feast for the district
district_feast.description: Food and noise for everyone. It buys a little goodwill, once.

open_the_tables.label: Open the city's tables
open_the_tables.description: A feast for the whole city, paid from your stores. It does not cure having more land than you can run, but it buys time.
open_the_tables.result: Every district you hold is calmer.

records_office.label: Open a records office
records_office.description: Someone keeps the books on who owns, owes and works what. You can govern more land well.
records_office.result: Your reach grows by one district, for good.

set_up_a_court.label: Set up a court
set_up_a_court.description: Disputes go to a bench instead of a knife. Successions go smoother and tempers are lower.
set_up_a_court.result: Your districts are calmer for good, and a succession is less likely to split you.
